live_verification_notice: Every candidate_live_state is implemented_unverified_live: catalogue membership and fixture tests never prove live behavior. Only rows with historical_evidence carry representative_variant_verified_existing_deployment proof, and that proof is limited to the exact variant described on an existing deployment. Static binding metadata (destructive flag, accepted scopes, static HTTP methods) is admission-time description, never conditional approval of a native variant.
limitations: Historical evidence covers only representative variants on an existing deployment and never constitutes whole-tool, whole-service or exhaustive candidate acceptance.
Rows without historical_evidence are historically unverified; proof is never inferred from tool name prefix, fixture presence or catalogue membership.
accepted_scopes lists alternatives declared by the runner binding, not a claim that every listed scope is required for every method.
http_methods_known=false marks a binding that declares no static method; no HTTP method is inferred.
destructive_binding_flag is the static admission flag from the runner binding; a false value does not guarantee that every variant is non-destructive.
